children: HealthStream entered into a Second Amendment to its Amended and Restated Revolving Credit Agreement, maintaining a $50 million unsecured revolving facility with Truist Bank and other lenders through September 10, 2031. The facility includes $5 million sublimits for swingline loans and standby letters of credit, plus a $25 million accordion subject to lender commitments. Initial pricing is base rate plus 0.50% or Term SOFR plus 1.50%, with a 0.20% commitment fee on unused amounts and customary financial covenants, including a maximum 3.0x net funded leverage and minimum 3.0x interest coverage. The amendment is intended to preserve liquidity and support strategic flexibility.
: Unsecured revolving credit facility (amended); $50 million capacity
: Truist Bank, as Administrative Agent, and other lenders
